bug.title: The artifact's turnover_series still renders the equal-weight book, so it disagrees with the signal-weighted turnover scalar it is meant to be the per-date record of
bug.symptoms: - After 720f8f4, compute_node_metrics computes turnover over the node's own book, with weights w_i = z_i / sum(|z_j|). - evaluator._artifact.render_turnover_series (~line 275) still rebuilds an equal-weight book (1/n over each date's priced symbols) from the PostCostReturns panel. It receives no scores, so it cannot know the weights. - test_persist.py::test_turnover_series_matches_the_metrics_turnover now fails: the mean of the rendered series is 0.5, and the scalar is 0.1667. - NodeMetrics carries book_returns (compare=False) but no per-date weights or per-date turnover. - Three tests in test_metrics.py still pin the replaced convention: - test_ir_standalone_is_the_equal_weight_books_information_ratio - test_ir_standalone_is_refused_when_the_book_return_is_constant: its fixture's equal-weight book is constant, but its signal book is not. - test_turnover_is_the_mean_fractional_turnover
bug.reproduction_steps: PYTHONPATH=src:packages/evaluator/src uv run --no-sync pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider packages/evaluator/tests -n 1: 4 failed.
bug.expected: - NodeMetrics carries the per-date turnover of its own book: turnover_series, a mapping from date to float, compare=False, empty on a record rebuilt from the store. This mirrors book_returns. compute_node_metrics fills it from the same per_date_weights its turnover scalar reduces. - render_turnover_series renders metrics.turnover_series when it is present, so the mean of the rendered series equals metrics.turnover by construction. - If a record rebuilt from the store has an empty turnover_series, rendering it is refused with EvaluatorArtifactError naming the reason. It never falls back to the equal-weight book. - The existing node-id and type checks stay. - The three test_metrics.py tests are rewritten to the signal-weighted convention, and their intent is preserved: - the IR test computes the expected IR from w = z / sum(|z|) by hand - the constant-book refusal uses a fixture whose signal book is genuinely constant (a refusal is still raised) - the turnover test's expected value is recomputed by hand for the signal weights, with the arithmetic in a comment - test_turnover_series_signal_book.py covers: - the rendered series' mean equals metrics.turnover for a panel where the scored symbols differ from the priced symbols - two signals with different weights over one panel render different series - a record without turnover_series is refused, not equal-weighted It passes under pytest-xdist. - The whole evaluator member suite passes.
bug.actual: Root cause: 720f8f4 moved the book to signal weights in _metrics.py only. _artifact.py re-derives turnover independently from the returns panel, with no access to the weights.
bug.constraints: ir_standalone, turnover, ic_mean and ic_tstat values from compute_node_metrics are unchanged The metrics store's persisted columns are unchanged No file outside the four listed is edited Do not edit docs/user-journeys/
